verdict.rationale: The Colorado Secretary of State is a government business-registry and filing portal, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external tool servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such client capability. The keyless open-data API on data.colorado.gov is a data source, not an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
